scope: scope-(a): at m = 3 no element-level representative meeting BOTH conditions exists using ONE relation (exhaustive over 1097) or TWO relations sharing a non-special argument (exhaustive over the shared-element pair class). Disjoint pairs are excluded structurally: max in-relation repetition is 2 < 3, so mu* = 3 forces 3 | c and z_2's multiplicity stays 1 mod 3. OPEN and explicitly not searched: three or more relations forming a chain of shared non-special arguments. Says nothing about eps_m as a map, nor about a construction that PINS the roots.
